steps.title: Prepare tiprack
steps.instruction: Remove tips from rows B, D, F, and H of the tiprack so the multi‑channel pipette can access the isopaks.

steps.title: Arrange source and destination isopaks
steps.instruction: Place source isopaks and empty destination isopaks according to the number of samples:

substeps.instruction: If running 24 samples, use one source isopak and replicate it into 7 destination isopaks.
If running 48 samples, put source isopak 1 in slot 10 to supply empty isopaks in slots 1, 2, 3 and source isopak 2 in slot 11 to supply empty isopaks in slots 4, 5, 6.
If the “Use middle two columns?” option is selected, ignore the middle two columns of the source isopaks and the middle two tubes of the destination isopaks during dispensing.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters before running the protocol:

substeps.instruction: Use middle two columns? – select Yes or No.
Sample Volume – specify the volume to replicate (in µL).
P300 Mount – select which mount (left or right) will hold the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Aspirate multiples of sample volume
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, aspirate as many multiples of the specified sample volume as possible from each source isopak column.

steps.title: Dispense sample volume to isopaks
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume from each source column into destination isopaks column‑by‑column, covering as many destination isopaks as possible and re‑aspirating if additional volume is needed.

steps.title: Change tips between source columns
steps.instruction: After completing dispensing from a source isopak column, discard the tip and pick up a fresh tip before moving to the next source column.
